## The finding, confirmed by a whole-feature audit

The value `4` (how many colour swatches show per pagination page) is independently declared five times, with nothing keeping them in sync:

```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:13          const SWATCHES_PER_PAGE = 4;
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts:41   const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.test.tsx:204    const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.test.tsx:233    const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.test.tsx:258    const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
```

All five currently agree, so nothing is broken today — but nothing enforces they stay that way. The `.css.ts` file's own comment admits this: *"If `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` in index.tsx ever changes, update this to match."*

## The fix — follow the existing `footerShared.ts` pattern exactly

Read `overrides/app/theme/components/footerShared.ts` first — this codebase already has the precedent for "a value more than one co-located file needs": one small shared module that the others import from, rather than each retyping the literal.

1. Create a new shared module: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`, exporting exactly one named constant:
   ```ts
   /** Swatches shown per pagination page. Shared so index.tsx, the recipe, and the test file
    * can never disagree with each other. */
   export const SWATCHES_PER_PAGE = 4;
   ```
   Match `footerShared.ts`'s own comment style/tone.

2. In `index.tsx`, replace the local `const SWATCHES_PER_PAGE = 4;` declaration with an import from the new shared module. Do not rename the identifier anywhere it's used in this file — only change where it comes from.

3. In `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`, replace the local `const PAGE_SIZE = 4;` with an import of `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` from the same shared module. You may keep a local `const PAGE_SIZE = SWATCHES_PER_PAGE;` alias if the rest of the file's code reads more clearly with the shorter name, or rename all its uses to `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` directly — your call, but do not leave a second independently-typed literal `4` anywhere in this file.

4. In `index.test.tsx`, replace all three local `const PAGE_SIZE = 4;` declarations with a single import of `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` from the shared module at the top of the file (or `PAGE_SIZE` if you kept that alias in the recipe — pick one name and use it consistently across all three test sites, don't mix).

## What NOT to do

Do not touch `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/` (a separate fix is being planned for that file, do not create a merge conflict with it). Do not touch `index.stories.tsx` — it doesn't reference this constant. Do not touch `overrides/app/theme/components/footerShared.ts` itself — it's Tier 2, read-only precedent here, not something this fix touches. Do not rename `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` to anything else, and do not change the actual value away from `4` — this is a structural fix, not a behaviour change.

## Verification — run yourself, report exact output

```
npx tsc --noEmit
npm run lint
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.test.tsx
npm run test
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
grep -rn "PAGE_SIZE\s*=\s*4\|SWATCHES_PER_PAGE\s*=\s*4" overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/
```

Expected: `tsc` 0 errors. The scoped test file still shows all 13 tests passing (no behaviour change, so no test should need its assertions changed — only where the constant comes from). Full suite matches the current baseline exactly (28 files / 432 tests) — you're not adding or removing a test, only refactoring where a constant lives. `lint`/`audit:tokens` unchanged from baseline. The final grep should show exactly ONE hit — the single declaration inside the new shared module — confirming every other site now imports rather than retypes.

Report back: the exact content of the new shared file, confirmation of exactly which files changed (should be the new shared file plus edits to `index.tsx`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`, and `index.test.tsx` — four files total, one of them new), and the final grep output proving there's now exactly one declaration.

102	      flex: '1 0 0',
103	      minWidth: 0,
104	      overflow: 'hidden',
105	      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
106	      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
107	    },

113	      // is no confirmed design value either way for a 2- or 3-colour row's width, so nothing was

115	      //
116	      // Paginated (> SWATCHES_PER_PAGE populated colours, windowed to a fixed PAGE_SIZE-wide
117	      // slice per page): a plain `100%` here resolves against `root`'s own width — but `root` has
118	      // no explicit width of its own, so it auto-fits to its widest child, which is this very
119	      // element. That circular relationship meant the *rendered* width tracked how many items the
120	      // current window actually held (192px for a full 4-item page, 96px for a 2-item final
121	      // page), so `root` — and `label` above it, itself 100% of that same `root` — visibly
122	      // resized between pages. Confirmed directly in a running Storybook: the pagination chevrons

127	      // `justify-content: flex-start` already left-aligns the rendered items, so nothing further

135	      gap: 0,
136	    },

138	    pagination: {

140	      alignItems: 'center',
141	      // No inter-button gap value exists in the Figma export handed to this step — left at the
142	      // flex default (no `gap` declared at all) rather than invented. Revisit if a designer
143	      // confirms a real value.
144	    },
145

147	      display: 'flex',
148	      alignItems: 'center',
149	      justifyContent: 'center',
150	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
151	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
152	      // Resets the native <button> UA chrome so the box is exactly the 24x24 the design calls
153	      // for, with the 16px ZimmIcon centred inside it by the flex alignment above.
154	      padding: 0,
155	      border: 'none',

157	      cursor: 'pointer',
158	      // No confirmed Figma spec for a disabled visual treatment on this control — same "leave an

161	      // attribute (set in index.tsx) already makes the control genuinely inert and announces as
162	      // disabled to assistive tech; only the cursor affordance is set here, which is a UX
163	      // keyword, not a design token.
164	      _disabled: {
165	        cursor: 'not-allowed',
166	      },
167	      // Same uniform ring every other interactive control in ui-kits/ uses (zimmColourSwatch,
168	      // zimmNavItem) — --zimm-focus-ring already composites the border-width/colour pair.
169	      _focusVisible: {
170	        outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
171	        outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
172	      },
173	    },
174	  }),
